entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Quintus Serenus Sammonicus was a Roman savant and tutor to Geta and Caracalla who became fatally involved in politics; he was also author of a didactic medical poem, Liber Medicinalis, probably incomplete in the extant form, as well as many lost works.
